footnote_text: Represents a grant of restricted stock units ("RSUs") to the Reporting Person pursuant to the Deep Isolation Nuclear, Inc. 2025 Equity Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock upon vesting. The RSUs shall vest as follows: 14,649 RSUs on September 29, 2027, 14,648 RSUs on September 29, 2028, 14,649 RSUs on September 29, 2029 and 14,648 RSUs on September 29, 2030, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service through each vesting date.
